newsitem.title: UK: U.S. Phoenix opens London reinsurance office.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Phoenix opens London reinsurance office.

text.p: Phoenix Home Life Mutual Insurance Company said its reinsurance unit has opened a representative office in London in response to growing global demand for reinsurance services and products.

American Phoenix Life & Reassurance Company (APLAR) will operate under the name of APLAR Services Ltd and will be headed by Philip Long, who has been in the life insurance business for 30 years, the company said in a statement.
"We intend to become better known outside the United States as a significant provider of quality products and services to companies that write individual and group life insurance," he said.
The Hartford, Connecticut, based Phoenix group said it has assets under management of approximately $40 billion and writes morethan $15 billion in new life reinsurance annually.
"We believe the international reinsurance market has strong potential," said Richard Booth, executive vice president, strategic development.
The London reinsurance office is part of the Phoenix group's strategy to expand its insurance and investment business worldwide.
